title: Enforce 2-byte 16-bit PCM sample alignment on dispatched SSE audio chunks

violation.problem: The audio:delta event handler in createNarrationStream pushes raw byte arrays directly to the SSE queue. If a delta has an odd byte count, a 16-bit PCM sample is split across network packets, desynchronizing the client player's sample clock.
violation.expectedSolution: Buffer trailing odd bytes in createNarrationStream so all dispatched SSE audio event payloads have an even byte length (16-bit sample aligned).

steps: In studio/src/lib/narration-server.ts, export alignAudioDelta(chunk: Uint8Array, carry: Uint8Array | null): { aligned: Uint8Array; carry: Uint8Array | null } helper.
In alignAudioDelta, combine chunk with carry, return even-length slice as aligned, and any leftover trailing byte as carry.
In createNarrationStream(), maintain a carry buffer across audio:delta events and dispatch only aligned bytes to the SSE queue.
Flush any remaining carry byte on stream completion.
reviewChecklist: All SSE audio deltas emitted to the client are 2-byte aligned
No dropped audio samples on stream completion
Total byte counts and duration calculations match actual emitted samples
